evaluation_stdlib: All Windows variants use identical official Windows Arm64 and WASM target standard libraries; Linux uses official Linux Arm64 and the same WASM components
secondary_endpoints: All original graphics and direct yuv native/WASM metadata/full endpoints, CPU and wall, one/four CPUs
order: Deterministic counterbalanced rotation by VM and round; reverse alternate rounds; all variants on the same Windows VM
primary_optimization_contrast: baseline-lld minus optimized: combined rustc PGO, LLVM PGO, cross-crate Rust ThinLTO and LLVM ThinLTO
linker_control: baseline-msvc minus baseline-lld; LLD plus LLVM's bitcode-capable librarian
attribution: (mean baseline-lld time - mean optimized time) / (mean official Windows time - mean official Linux time)
historical_translation: Paired optimization saving as fraction of contemporary official Windows time, divided by historical Arm64 excess fraction; explicitly conditional on effect transfer
aggregation: Arithmetic mean of measured rounds within VM, then equal-weight mean across VMs; retain pairings
uncertainty: 10000 seeded cluster bootstrap draws, resampling whole Windows VMs and independently whole Linux VMs; 95% percentile intervals
baseline_equivalence_gate: 90% cluster-bootstrap interval for baseline-msvc/official lies wholly inside [0.95,1.05] for primary CPU endpoint; otherwise do not claim original-official-gap attribution
exclusions: Only failed/incomplete runs; no post-hoc slow-sample trimming. Warmups excluded by predeclared round index.
limitations: Optimization bundle, not separate PGO-versus-LTO attribution; Linux/Windows hardware not guaranteed identical; local SDK/tool versions and disabled DIA reader shared by custom compilers
